description: Review of the commit that added the exhaustive binding map and normalised aliases: inside a class body Python mangles `__omit` to `_TestA__omit`, which is not the module's `from pytest import skip as __omit` (the call raises NameError). A name subject to mangling is never certain: TG003 warns that 'adds' may be skipped, never FAIL; the real runner runs the test (it fails with NameError).
